public.title: MediLink for health facilities
public.problem: Patients waste hours in queues and carry paper records between facilities. MediLink gives your facility online booking, a live queue, digital records and insurance claims in one system, in Kinyarwanda, English and French.
public.sessionEnded: Your application is saved. We emailed you a link to continue it later.

admin.title: Facility administrators
admin.body: Set up services, schedules and staff accounts, and follow the facility's performance.

reception.title: Reception
reception.body: Check patients in, run the queue and record payments and insurance.

doctor.title: Doctors and nurses
doctor.body: See today's patients, their history and write consultations and prescriptions.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy
pharmacy.body: Receive electronic prescriptions and record what was dispensed.

apply.title: Apply
apply.body: Tell us about the facility and upload its licence and registration documents.

verify.title: Verification
verify.body: Our team checks the documents and may ask for changes.

setup.title: Setup
setup.body: Your administrator adds services, schedules and staff.

live.title: Live
live.body: Patients can find you and book online.

cost.a: Onboarding is free during the pilot. We will agree any subscription with you before it applies.

documents.a: Your Ministry of Health operating licence. Private facilities also need their RDB registration and TIN certificate.

time.a: Usually a few working days after you submit a complete application.

data.q: Who can see our patients' data?
data.a: Only your staff, and the patients themselves. Data stays in Rwanda and access is logged.

start.title: Register your facility
start.intro: Start with a few details. You can save and continue later: we email you a link.
start.emailHint: We send the link to continue your application to this address.

resume.title: Continue your application
resume.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new link below.
resume.linkBody: Enter the email you applied with. If there is an open application, we send you a link to continue it.
resume.linkSent: If there is an open application for this address, a link is on its way. Check your email.

submitted.title: Application submitted
submitted.sessionOver: Your application was submitted. We will email you about the next steps.
submitted.next1: We check your documents, usually within a few working days.
submitted.next2: If something is missing, we email you a link to make changes.
submitted.next3: Once approved, we invite your facility administrator to set up MediLink.

wizard.title: Facility application
wizard.sessionOver: Your session for this application has ended. Ask for a new link to continue.

save.conflict: This application changed somewhere else. We reloaded the latest version; check your last change.

location.addressHint: For example: KG 11 Ave 5, next to the market.
location.outsideRwanda: That location is outside Rwanda. Stand at the facility and try again, or skip this.
location.geoDenied: We couldn't get your location. You can skip this.
location.geoUnavailable: Your browser can't share a location. You can skip this.

documents.intro: Upload clear photos or PDFs. Each file is checked for viruses before our team can open it.
documents.chooseOwnership: Choose the ownership on the Facility step to see which documents you need.
documents.numberRequired: Add the licence number and expiry date, then upload the licence again.
documents.insurersHint: Optional. Add a contract for each insurer if you have one.

upload.hint: PDF, JPEG, PNG or HEIC, up to 10 MB.
upload.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB.
upload.wrongType: Upload a PDF, JPEG, PNG or HEIC file.

admin.intro: Who will manage MediLink at the facility? We invite this person once the facility is approved.
admin.name: Administrator's full name

review.terms: I accept the MediLink terms of use for facilities.
review.dpa: I accept the data processing agreement on behalf of the facility.
review.ncsa: I confirm the facility is registered with the National Cyber Security Authority as a data controller, or will be before going live.

documents.moh_licence: MoH operating licence with number and expiry

validation.email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
